reviews.comment: The Fall 2019 semester was Dr. Xus first semester at TAMU. Hes a really good prof. His teaching is okay and I had to go get extra tutoring to clarify things. But as for his exams they are the EXACT same as his homework . He picks about 6 problems from the homework and makes that the exam . Only grades in this class is HW and Exams. Take him!!!
